about: The grade table on the Review summary: the White and Black headers centred over their digits, and the Best, Excellent and Good dots told apart by colour (each pair dE76 >= 15, each >= 10 from every other grade), on the Desk default taken at #553 (flags/amber-553-grade-dot-colours: keep the CLS_BANDS colours #6fd66f / #9fcf6f / #c9d06a). Graded by gate 193 (TC-R321..323) on the Opera Game's summary at 375x761 with his insets and 320x568, dots read from painted pixels. NOT COVERED: whether he likes the greens (his look).

breaks.name: dots-back-to-three-shades-of-green
breaks.why: the three green dots go back to the #422 shades rgb(123,216,143), (139,209,143), (156,203,143), about dE 8 apart - the defect filed

breaks.name: excellent-dot-painted-as-best
breaks.why: the Excellent dot paints Best's colour, so only its word tells the two rows apart

breaks.name: header-grid-48-again
breaks.why: the header row's grid is 1fr 48px 48px again over rows of 1fr 56px 56px, so White and Black sit right of their digits
